answer: Every agent docks at the network wharf each epoch to pay a funding-correlation toll. Wallets traced to shared upstream funders are grouped, and each member pays k^1.6 units of fresh per-epoch work, where k is its cluster size — work that cannot be amortized by staked capital. Funding provenance is read like shale: each stratum of shared history raises a layer multiplier, so hidden clone fleets surface. One identity pays 1; ten funded clones pay 40 each — a fleet climbing the dune pays steeply for every extra body, while a lone agent walks flat. Sybil budgets shatter long before they scale.
